name: Facet
text:
Ship a live contrast checker that runs *after* every major design change, not before submission.

This catches contrast issues early when fixes are cheap, not late when they derail schedules. The trade-off is a small performance hit during active design, but that’s better than last-minute rework or inaccessible visuals.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A live checker after every change risks training us to ignore warnings until they pile up—then we’re still fixing derailers late. Instead, make the checker *part of the design loop*: if a change drops contrast below AA, the tool blocks submission until fixed. Settle it by testing both: measure how often the post-change checker catches issues versus how many we ignore versus how many the gatekeeper blocks.
